skills.label: Reading and comparing data
skills.description: Select relevant values, compare groups, find missing totals and recognise when information is insufficient.
skills.tip: Read the row, column, axis and unit before calculating. Check that the information really supports an answer.

skills.label: Percentage change
skills.description: Calculate increases, decreases, percentage-point gaps, reverse changes and successive percentage changes.
skills.tip: Identify the original value. For percentage change, divide the change by that original value; multiply successive changes rather than adding them.

skills.label: Fractions and percentage shares
skills.description: Find a fraction or percentage of a quantity, recover a whole from a known share and compare parts with the right whole.
skills.tip: Write down which quantity represents the whole before dividing. Keep part-of-total percentages separate from percentage changes.

skills.label: Ratios and proportion
skills.description: Simplify and compare ratios, divide quantities into parts and scale recipes, populations or material requirements.
skills.tip: Find one part or one unit first, then scale. For an area scale, square the length scale.

skills.label: Speed, rates and density
skills.description: Use quantities per unit, combine work or flow rates and calculate speed from total distance and total time.
skills.tip: Write the rate with its units, then multiply or divide. For a combined speed, use total distance divided by total time.

skills.label: Units and conversions
skills.description: Convert time, length, mass, volume, currency units and compound units consistently.
skills.tip: Convert to matching units before calculating. Minutes are fractions of 60, and squared or cubed units need squared or cubed conversion factors.

skills.label: Averages and spread
skills.description: Calculate means, weighted means, medians and ranges, and recover missing values from a mean.
skills.tip: Check whether every value has equal weight. For a missing value, recover the total from mean × count first.

skills.label: Geometry and measurement
skills.description: Find area, perimeter, surface area and volume, including composite shapes and scale models.
skills.tip: Sketch the relevant dimensions. Separate area from perimeter, and use radius rather than diameter in circle formulas.

skills.label: Formulas and algebra
skills.description: Substitute into given formulas, apply caps or inequalities and rearrange equations to find an unknown.
skills.tip: Write the formula before entering numbers. When working backwards, undo operations in reverse order.

skills.label: Costs, revenue and pricing bands
skills.description: Combine fees, revenue and costs, apply pricing bands and compare complete costs or budgets.
skills.tip: List each charge separately. Apply a band only to the amount inside it, then include fixed charges and the stated tax or discount.

skills.label: Routes and elapsed time
skills.description: Compare connected routes, add journey stages and breaks, and calculate elapsed or arrival times.
skills.tip: List each journey stage and each break. Check route connections and count gaps between events carefully.
